title: Remote gateway browser cookies remain scoped to each workspace
description: Synthetic local browser transport regression, followed separately by real guest validation. This case makes no Firebase login or real-host acceptance claim.

requires.fixture: Run node vm-gateway/workspaceBrowser.fixture.js; it binds loopback only and uses synthetic credentials and targets

steps.expected: Open /workspaces/alpha/agent/?mapache_access=fixture-alpha and /workspaces/beta/agent/?mapache_access=fixture-beta in two tabs of the same Chrome profile. Both redirect without the token and display matching HTTP and WebSocket identities.
In alpha then beta then alpha, run window.probe() through DevTools. Each returns its own HTTP and WebSocket identity with status 200 after the other workspace has opened.
Reload both tabs without query tokens and repeat probes. Inspect cookies: both are HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None, with distinct /workspaces/alpha/agent and /workspaces/beta/agent paths.

Inspect Network: the compiled-style preload helper and CSS font/image URLs stay under each workspace prefix. No /agent root asset request, failed request, or unexpected console error occurs during loading or reload.
Request the beta path with fixture-alpha as the query token. It returns 404, sets no cookie, and does not change beta's subsequent probe result.
